product_overview: Appcrons is a backend service that keeps free-tier Render.com backend instances alive by sending scheduled HTTP pings and recording ping metrics. This PRD covers the HTTP APIs for authentication, app management, request scheduling/RTFs, admin operations, feedback/bug reports, and monitoring endpoints (see PRD pages 1-3 and API reference pages 6-14).
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based user and admin authentication and user profile management.
Allow users to register applications to be pinged at configurable intervals and define daily Request Time Frames (RTFs).
Record and expose ping logs and live ping events; ensure scheduler respects RTFs and uses Redis locks for multi-instance safety.
Expose admin endpoints for system-wide stats and user/app inspection (sys_admin only).
Accept and manage user feedback and unauthenticated bug reports; provide health and Prometheus metrics endpoints.

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Register and authenticate users and admins, manage passwords, and retrieve/update user profiles (public signup/signin endpoints issue JWTs which protect other routes). See PRD pages 6-7 for request/response examples and edge cases.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/signup with body {"name":"Alice Nakato","email":"alice.nakato@gmail.com","password":"Secure@1234"} -> Receive 201 with {status:"success", data:{user:{id:"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8",name:"Alice Nakato",email:"alice.nakato@gmail.com"}, token:"<jwt>"}} -> POST /api/v1/auth/signin with body {"email":"alice.nakato@gmail.com","password":"Secure@1234"} -> Receive 200 with {status:"success", data:{user:{...}, token:"<jwt2>"}} -> GET /api/v1/auth/user/get/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 with Authorization: Bearer <jwt2> -> Receive 200 with user profile
POST /api/v1/auth/signup with body missing "email" -> Receive 400 with {status:"error", message:"validation error", errors:["email is required"]}
POST /api/v1/auth/signup with duplicate email "alice.nakato@gmail.com" -> Receive 409 with {status:"error", message:"user with this email already exists"}
POST /api/v1/auth/signin with correct email and wrong password -> Receive 401 with {status:"error", message:"invalid credentials"}
GET /api/v1/auth/user/get/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 with {status:"error", message:"missing or invalid token"}

PATCH /api/v1/auth/user/update/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 with Authorization: Bearer <valid token> and body {"name":"Alice Updated"} -> Receive 200 with updated user -> PATCH /api/v1/auth/user/update-password/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 with Authorization header and invalid short password -> Receive 400 with {status:"error", message:"password too short"}

features.name: App Management API
features.description: Create, read, update, enable/disable, search, and delete applications that Appcrons will ping. All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <token>. Default new apps must have isEnabled=false (see PRD pages 8-10 for edge cases and expected status codes).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/apps/post with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> and body {"name":"My Render API","url":"https://my-api.onrender.com/active","requestInterval":10} -> Receive 201 with {status:"success", data:{app:{id:"3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d",userId:"6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8",name:"My Render API",url:"https://my-api.onrender.com/active",requestInterval:10,isEnabled:false}}}
GET /api/v1/apps/get-by-user with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> -> Receive 200 with {status:"success", data:{apps:[...]}} (returns only apps owned by the authenticated user)
PATCH /api/v1/apps/update/3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> and body {"name":"Updated API","requestInterval":15} -> Receive 200 with updated app

PATCH /api/v1/apps/enable/3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> -> Receive 200 with isEnabled:true (idempotent; enabling an already enabled app -> 200 with isEnabled:true)
PATCH /api/v1/apps/disable/3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> -> Receive 200 with isEnabled:false (idempotent)
POST /api/v1/apps/post with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> and body with url "http://insecure.example.com" (non-HTTPS) -> Receive 400 with {status:"error", message:"invalid url: must use https"}
GET /api/v1/apps/get/3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d with Authorization: Bearer <bob-token> (Bob is not owner) -> Receive 403 with {status:"error", message:"forbidden"}
DELETE /api/v1/apps/delete/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> -> Receive 404 with {status:"error", message:"app not found"}
DELETE /api/v1/apps/delete/3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 with {status:"error", message:"missing or invalid token"}

features.name: Requests API (Request Time Frames & Ping Logs)
features.description: Manage request time frames (RTFs), define active intervals for pings, and retrieve ping logs and live SSE events. All protected endpoints require Authorization (see PRD pages 11-13 for RTF validation and logs requirements).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/requests/post-request-time with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> and body {"appId":"3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d","startTime":"06:00","endTime":"23:00","timezone":"Africa/Kampala"} -> Receive 201 with {status:"success", data:{requestTime:{id:"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",appId:...,startTime:"06:00",endTime:"23:00",timezone:"Africa/Kampala"}}}

POST /api/v1/requests/post-request-time with Authorization and body where startTime >= endTime (e.g. {"startTime":"23:00","endTime":"06:00"}) -> Receive 400 with {status:"error", message:"startTime must be before endTime"}

PATCH /api/v1/requests/update-request-time/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890 with Authorization and body {"startTime":"07:00","endTime":"22:00"} -> Receive 200 with updated RTF -> DELETE /api/v1/requests/delete-request-time/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890 with Authorization -> Receive 200 or 204; second DELETE attempt -> Receive 404

GET /api/v1/requests/get-by-app?appId=3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d with Authorization -> Receive 200 with {status:"success", data:{requests:[{id:...,statusCode:200,duration:342,madeAt:"2026-04-14T07:00:00Z"},...]}}

GET /api/v1/requests/get-live with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> -> Receive 200 SSE stream of live request events; missing or expired token -> Receive 401 with {status:"error", message:"unauthorized"}

features.name: Admin API
features.description: System administration endpoints for sys_admin users to list users, inspect their apps and requests, and retrieve system statistics. All admin endpoints require a sys_admin JWT (see PRD page 11).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/signin-admin with body {"email":"admin@example.com","password":"AdminPass"} -> Receive 200 with {status:"success", data:{user:{...}, token:"<admin-jwt>"}} -> GET /api/v1/admin/users with Authorization: Bearer <admin-jwt> -> Receive 200 with list of users
GET /api/v1/admin/users/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8/apps with Authorization: Bearer <admin-jwt> -> Receive 200 with that user's apps
GET /api/v1/admin/users/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8/apps/3d6f4890-7b21-41d5-b2d3-4f9e8c6a1b2d/requests with Authorization: Bearer <admin-jwt> -> Receive 200 with app request logs
GET /api/v1/admin/stats with Authorization: Bearer <regular-user-token> (not sys_admin) -> Receive 403 with {status:"error", message:"forbidden"}
GET /api/v1/admin/users with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 with {status:"error", message:"missing or invalid token"}

features.name: Feedback API
features.description: Authenticated endpoints for users to submit and manage feedback entries and for admins to list all feedback (protected by JWT).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/feedback/post with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> and body {"message":"Love the service","rating":5} -> Receive 201 with created feedback entry
GET /api/v1/feedback/get-by-user with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> -> Receive 200 with array of that user's feedback entries
GET /api/v1/feedback/get-all with Authorization: Bearer <admin-jwt> -> Receive 200 with all feedback entries

PATCH /api/v1/feedback/update/<feedbackId> with Authorization: Bearer <user-token> and body {"message":"Updated message"} -> Receive 200 with updated feedback -> PATCH with non-existent feedbackId -> Receive 404 with {status:"error", message:"not found"}
POST /api/v1/feedback/post with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 with {status:"error", message:"missing or invalid token"}

features.name: Bug Report API
features.description: Endpoints for submitting bug reports. Bug reporting endpoints are unauthenticated by design so users can report issues without logging in (see codebase endpoints).
user_flows: POST /api/v1/bugreport/post with body {"title":"Ping failing","description":"Pings return 503"} and no Authorization header -> Receive 201 with created bug report (status:"success")
GET /api/v1/bugreport/get-all -> Receive 200 with array of bug reports

GET /api/v1/bugreport/get-by-user (unauthenticated) with query param userId=6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 -> Receive 200 with array of reports for that user (if implemented) or 400 if malformed userId -> Receive 400 with {status:"error", message:"malformed uuid"}
POST /api/v1/bugreport/post with malformed body (missing required fields) -> Receive 400 with {status:"error", message:"validation error"}

features.name: Miscellaneous / Monitoring API
features.description: Simple unauthenticated endpoints for health checks and Prometheus metrics used by monitoring and uptime checks (see PRD page 14).
user_flows: GET /get/active -> Receive 200 with small keep-alive payload (used by external pingers to keep service alive)
GET /metrics -> Receive 200 with Prometheus metrics plaintext body
GET /metrics with heavy load -> Receive 200 (metrics should be served even under higher load); any server error -> Receive 500 with {status:"error", message:"internal server error"}
